items.prompt: An old laboratory egg incubator with a glass lid on a bench in a dim room; inside, instead of eggs, a small glowing blue planet rests in the warm light of the incubator lamp, wisps of cloud visible on it.

alt.ru: Старый лабораторный инкубатор со стеклянной крышкой на столе в полутёмной комнате; внутри вместо яиц в тёплом свете лампы лежит маленькая светящаяся планета с облаками.
alt.en: An old lab incubator with a glass lid on a bench in a dim room; inside, instead of eggs, a small glowing planet with wisps of cloud rests in the warm lamplight.
alt.pt: Uma velha incubadora de laboratório com tampa de vidro numa sala escura; lá dentro, em vez de ovos, um pequeno planeta luminoso com nuvens repousa sob a lâmpada.
alt.es: Una vieja incubadora de laboratorio con tapa de cristal en una sala en penumbra; dentro, en lugar de huevos, un pequeño planeta luminoso con nubes descansa bajo la lámpara.

items.prompt: Night on a dacha porch: a man sits on the steps with a grey cat on his knees, and a young dark-haired woman has quietly sat down beside him; both look out at the black forest, a faint light from the house behind them.

alt.ru: Ночь на крыльце дачи: мужчина сидит на ступеньках с серым котом на коленях, рядом тихо села темноволосая девушка, оба смотрят на чёрный лес.
alt.en: Night on a dacha porch: a man on the steps with a grey cat on his knees, a dark-haired young woman quietly sitting beside him, both looking at the black forest.
alt.pt: Noite no alpendre de uma dacha: um homem nos degraus com um gato cinzento nos joelhos, uma jovem de cabelo escuro sentada ao lado, ambos a olhar a floresta negra.
alt.es: Noche en el porche de una dacha: un hombre en los escalones con un gato gris en las rodillas, una joven de pelo oscuro sentada a su lado, ambos mirando el bosque negro.
